event.loss: The crew was not injured. Nothing was stolen.

sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2024
sources.text: While anchored, four perpetrators boarded the ship from stern while three watch keepers were taking rounds on deck. The starboard watch keeper saw the perpetrators onboard and raised the alarm immediately. Upon realising the crew was alerted, the perpetrators jumped overboard. The crew was not injured and nothing was stolen. The ship informed Dumai VTS about the incident and Indonesian authorities arrived on scene to provide assistance.
